_about: Poisoned-input corpus for the guard_text fence (#560). Each case is text a stranger can put in front of an unattended worker. expect_labels names the INJECTION-PATTERN families the fence must raise somewhere in the envelope; fence_expect documents the two honest outcomes: 'labelled' (the fence catches the shape) and 'envelope-only' (the fence cannot see this class — the control is the worker-obedience drill and the spawn env, and the case exists so nobody mistakes envelope for detection).
